title: Existence and uniqueness of normalized individual decalage page isomorphisms
statement: Let \(C\) be abelian, \(U\) a filtered cochain complex, \(p,q,r\in\mathbb Z\), and \(r\ge2\). There exists a unique isomorphism from the fixed original quotient-page object [lem-sp-filtered-complex-canonical-model] to the decalage spectral-object page [def-sp-filtered-complex-decalage-tower] satisfying \(\mathrm{FilteredComplexDecalagePageIsoProperty}\) [def-sp-filtered-complex-decalage-page-data]. Thus it sends every actual cycle representative to its own right-interval cohomology class. This asserts neither differential nor successor compatibility.

proof.text: Identify imageSubobject(c_r) with the subobject of the monic page embedding, and compose factorThruImageSubobject(c_r) with Subobject.isoOfEqMk to obtain an epimorphism b onto the spectral page, satisfying b≫embedding=c_r.

proof.text: The representative projection followed by the original page projection is epic. Its kernel is kernel(c_r), and monicity of the embedding identifies this with kernel(b). A map kills the kernel of the other epi by the kernel-subobject inclusion. Use Mathlib Abelian.epiDesc to construct maps in both directions, and cancel the two epis to prove that these maps are inverse.

proof.text: The comparison equation gives the requested normalization for one representative projection. Every other projection with the same ambient square equals it by monicity of the graded cycle inclusion. Cancellation gives the property for all projections and uniqueness of the isomorphism.

theorem filteredComplex_decalage_page_iso
    (U : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ)) (p q r : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) :
    ∃! e : filteredComplexPageObject U.obj U.filtration r (p, q) ≅
      ((((filteredComplexDecalageSpectralObjectFunctor C).obj U).E₂SpectralSequence).page
        r hr).X (p, q),
      FilteredComplexDecalagePageIsoProperty U p q r hr e
